title: Tooling: 2.25× faster mixed-point scalar digests with identical receipts
body:
## Change and scope

At base `0b1cccf86e2f5132ed286a26ef0a681a495740ea`, the historical mixed-point audit (`scripts/audit_mixed_point.py`) and the early-sharing screen both call `scalar_check` on large cancellation-free circuits. Profiling shows a large share of that helper’s time in per-node `json.dumps((node, args), …)` and per-output `json.dumps((i, node), …)` while building `circuit_sha256`.

This PR writes the same UTF-8 digest lines with an equivalent hand-rolled formatter (`[node,null]`, `[node,[a,b]]`, `[i,node]`), keeps every support and topology `require`, and leaves `circuit_sha256` unchanged. No certificate `source_sha256` pin lists `audit_mixed_point.py`; the mixed-point and early-sharing mathematical payloads stay fieldwise identical to the committed files.

**Tooling improvement; no new kappa.** Selected frontier untouched.

## Result

On Linux / CPython 3.12.3 (Linux-6.12.94+-x86_64-with-glibc2.39), five alternating fresh-process pairs timing only `scalar_check` on the fixed mixed-point circuit set gave median wall time **10.004 → 4.444 seconds (2.25×)**. Timing is host-descriptive and is not a correctness gate. Every scalar receipt matches the baseline checker fieldwise (`roles`, `circuit_sha256`, flags).

Package: `research/mixed-point-scalar-digest/`.

## Validation

```sh
python3.12 -I -B research/mixed-point-scalar-digest/verify.py
python3.12 -I -O -B research/mixed-point-scalar-digest/verify.py
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/mixed-point-scalar-digest
python3.12 -I -B research/mixed-point-scalar-digest/benchmark.py --rounds 5
```

Expected:

```text
PASS_MIXED_POINT_SCALAR_DIGEST scalar_cases=7 encoding_cases=5 certs=0 no_new_kappa
PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/mixed-point-scalar-digest outcome=completed
PASS_IDENTICAL_MIXED_POINT_SCALAR_RECEIPTS
```

Default verify is read-only. Full `make verify`, selected cold replay, Lean, and multiplication-theorem obligations were not rerun for this isolated historical-checker change.

## Overlap and credit

Closest priors (different objects): [CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds#756](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/756), [CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds#1793](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1793), [CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds#1861](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1861), [CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds#1922](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1922), [CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds#1217](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1217), and `research/rational-containment-performance/` (mixed-point `contained` adapter). Open [CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds#1874](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1874) optimizes a different hosted-audit digest path and does not touch `scalar_check`. No competing open PR on the `scalar_check` digest object at refresh.
